name: Two FDM 3D Printers
description: Two 3D printers for PLA, Soft PLA and other filaments — one of them funded by the lab's benefactors.

name: Complete Fabrication Toolset
description: A full set of hand and power tools, silicone casting and molding equipment for building robots and prototypes.

name: SCARA Robot
description: A SCARA manipulator for teaching and research in kinematics, trajectory planning and control.

name: Three-Link Robot Arm
description: A planar three-link (3R) manipulator for kinematics, dynamics and control experiments.

name: Space Robot Platform
description: A space-robot setup for studying the dynamics and control of manipulators on a moving base.

name: Continuum & Soft Robot Prototypes
description: Tendon-driven, fork-joint and pneumatic (PneuNet) robots built by lab members.

name: Workbenches & Electronics
description: Workbenches with microcontrollers, motor drivers, pressure regulators, power supplies and measurement tools.

name: Simulation & Computing
description: MATLAB/Simulink, Python, SOFA (SoftRobots), MuJoCo and ROS for modeling, simulation and control design.
